scope: Research-only semantic review of all relevant effective catalog records. No production or test edits.
identity_rule: A semantic claim attaches to an exact item ID. Similar names or shared recipes are candidate-generation signals only; they never substitute for exact-ID source evidence.
evidence_rules: Use OSRS Wiki pages and exact item-ID relations from the joined dataset; retain URLs and oldids when supplied. If the snapshot omits the per-page revision, record retrieval date 2026-10-02 and mark the revision unavailable.
Do not infer function from missing bucket categories, bonuses, recipe fields, or metadata; false category flags are not negative evidence.
Distinguish an item's base identity from each supported role: consumable, ingredient, intermediate, seed/plant state, restricted copy, and quest-only tool or item.
Do not collapse dose, serving, charged, region-limited, minigame, or workflow states when the source identifies them as behaviorally distinct.
Treat current bank tags, user overrides, and existing curated groupings as hypotheses and mismatch detectors, not semantic evidence.

deterministic_candidate_detectors.rule: Exact-ID records that source evidence identifies as the same drinkable potion with dose decrement progression may form an ordered family (4, 3, 2, 1); validate dose and empty-container transition independently.
Grimy herb, clean herb, and seed candidates are linked only when exact-ID page facts establish the same herb and seed product chain; retain special/quest herb identities separately.
Link base, unfinished potion, secondary, and final product using documented input/output relations. Shared secondaries may have multiple valid recipe roles.

Group exact-ID food variants only when the source establishes the same product and serving/depletion progression; retain bite count, healing timing/range, attack-delay role, and restriction as variant dimensions.
Keep otherwise similar food or potion item IDs distinct where Wiki facts identify area, minigame, league, quest, or one-use restrictions; report as possible base-family relations with variant role.
Candidate ingredients require a source-confirmed repeatable cooking/food recipe relation; a Cooking or food-related label alone is insufficient.

An exact-ID Wiki item row with Category:Potions true and an explicit 1–4-dose version_anchor may join the dose-state family for the same page_name, ordered by anchor. This proves a dose-labelled variant, not necessarily ordinary drinkability; retain quest/minigame/workflow categories and exact IDs.

confidence.high: Exact-ID source facts directly establish function and the proposed family/role.
confidence.medium: Exact-ID source confirms a relevant role, but family linkage or intended bank grouping remains ambiguous.
confidence.low: Candidate detection is supported only indirectly or by incomplete exact-ID facts; keep unresolved and do not recommend production classification.

source_snapshot_limit: The joined infobox rows do not include per-row revision IDs. URLs and 2026-10-02 retrieval time are available; mark oldid unavailable unless a separate sourced catalog metadata record supplies it.
